note: The reference text and line boundaries are for auditing, not model output.

lines.text: I have a recording from our product review. Can we turn it into searchable captions?
Yes. First, we send the audio to Nemotron Transcribe on one H one hundred GPU.
Will it tell us who is speaking and when each word starts?
That's the idea. We ask for speaker tags and word timestamps, then check the result against the recording.
Great. I can search for product review, jump to that moment, and export subtitle captions.
Exactly. The transcript is useful, but a human should still review names and speaker changes.
